summary: Iteration_10 verifies (1) all 8 Services-group pages render full RichBody with card-table, benefits, do's/don'ts, care, service scope, 7-item Extra Services grid, 5-question FAQ sidebar, and CTAs; (2) 'Enquire About X Makeup' navigates to /contact and pre-fills the Service dropdown correctly (Bridal, Engagement, Non-Bridal, Party, Groom, Editorial, Fashion, Photo Shoot — all match including the two new dropdown options Groom & Photo Shoot); (3) BrochureCta + BookingPanel still render below RichBody on Services pages; (4) /community shows coming-soon banner + 7-question community-faq grid mentioning Bridal/Engagement/Non-Bridal/Party/Groom/Fashion/Editorial; (5) Home pricing-section renders exactly 8 cards with correct titles/prices/routing (Bridal featured with 'Most booked' badge, Groom→/pre-wedding-photoshoot-makeup-artist, Fashion→/fashion-makeup); (6) GET /api/content/pricing returns exactly 8 items matching spec; (7) 390px mobile viewport shows no horizontal overflow on /engagement-makeup or Home; (8) Regression smoke: POST /api/enquiries 201, POST /api/auth/login 200 with admin creds, one location page (/bridal-makeup-Bangalore) renders card-table + FAQ. Everything green.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx reads sessionStorage 'rk_service' as the initial useState value. If a user navigates from a Services page /contact?service=X to /contact and the Contact component was already mounted (e.g. via SPA link), the URL param sync happens in ContactPage before Contact mounts so it works; however this coupling via sessionStorage is fragile — consider passing service via router state or reading useSearchParams directly inside Contact for a more idiomatic React pattern.

pageBodies.js line 199 (older /makeup-artist-for-pre-wedding-shoot SEO page) has 'Enquire About Photo Shoot Makeup' CTA pointing to service=Bridal — likely a leftover before Photo Shoot was added to the dropdown. Could be updated to service=Photo%20Shoot for consistency (not in the 8 tested pages, so not a blocker).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 Services pages, community FAQ, 8/8 pricing cards, mobile responsive, location regression)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_iter10 enquiry created via POST /api/enquiries (201). Admin can delete via existing enquiry management UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_10 verified all 8 Services group pages with rich content + extras + FAQ, community pricing FAQ, and Home 8-card pricing update (including new Groom/Fashion cards and 'Photo Shoot' + 'Groom' additions to the Contact service dropdown). No regressions detected. iteration_8 backend 16/16, iteration_9 11 location pages, iteration_10 8 services pages — full Services/Location/Pricing coverage is now green.
